hints.title: Subarray Offset Effect
hints.text: Adding a chosen value x to a subarray converts all instances of target = k - x into k.

hints.title: Net Gain Modeling
hints.text: Inside the subarray, each appearance of target yields +1 while each existing k loses 1.

hints.title: Kadane across Target Values
hints.text: Iterate through every possible target value from 1 to 50 and use Kadane algorithm to find the maximum net gain.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Executes Kadane algorithm across 50 possible values bounded by the problem constraints.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every subarray and delta choice takes cubic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Operates in constant auxiliary space by reusing running gain variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reformulates value substitution into maximum subarray problem via Kadane algorithm.
